message: Last night, we had a little storm that rattled the windows and sent my cat scurrying under the couch. Instead of panicking, I made some popcorn and settled in with a good book. It reminded me of the importance of being prepared, just in case. If you're curious about how to turn stormy weather into a cozy event, there are some great tips out there on how to stay safe and ready. After all, a little preparation can make any storm feel like an adventure! ☔️
